articles.title: Explosions rock Damascus on second day of Macron's visit to Syria
articles.summary: Explosions were heard in Damascus on Tuesday during French President Emmanuel Macron's visit to the Syrian capital, with witnesses reporting smoke rising near a high-end hotel.

articles.title: France's Macron in first post-Assad visit to Damascus: why the Syria stopover?
articles.summary: Emmanuel Macron visits Damascus for the first visit by a French President since Nicolas Sarkozy, following regional developments including Iran's leadership succession and Hamas disarmament in Gaza.

articles.title: Macron expected in Syria in first post-Assad visit by Western leader, Damascus says
articles.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron landed in Syria on Monday with a delegation including representatives of French companies and investors, marking the first such visit by a Western head of state.

articles.title: Macron's visit to Syria confirms normalisation strategy of post-Assad government
articles.summary: Syria receives its first Western European head of state visit since new leader Ahmed al-Sharaa took power in 2024, with Emmanuel Macron visiting to discuss bilateral relations and regional issues.

articles.title: Syria expecting Macron visit in first for Western head-of-state since Assad
articles.summary: Syria is expecting a visit by French President Emmanuel Macron, the first by a Western European head of state since Syria's new leader Ahmed al-Sharaa took power in 2024.
